```{ojs}
//| output: false
eventMetrics = FileAttachment("data/event_release.csv").csv({typed: true})
mortalityMetrics = FileAttachment("data/mortality_release.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
isPublishedNumber = row => {
  const status = String(row?.suppression_status ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()
  const value = Number(row?.display_value)
  return (status === "" || status === "none" || status === "not_applicable") && Number.isFinite(value)
}

complete = row => String(row?.period_complete) === "1"

monthKey = row =>
  String(row.period_year).padStart(4, "0") + "-" +
  String(row.period_month).padStart(2, "0")

monthSerial = key => {
  const [year, month] = key.split("-").map(Number)
  return year * 12 + month
}

monthDate = key => new Date(key + "-01T00:00:00Z")

shiftMonth = (key, offset) => {
  const [year, month] = key.split("-").map(Number)
  return d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m")(new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1 + offset, 1)))
}

monthLabel = key => d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(monthDate(key))
monthShortLabel = key => d3.utcFormat("%b")(monthDate(key))

monthRangeLabel = months => {
  if (!months?.length) return ""
  const start = monthDate(months[0])
  const end = monthDate(months[months.length - 1])
  const sameYear = d3.utcFormat("%Y")(start) === d3.utcFormat("%Y")(end)
  return sameYear
    ? d3.utcFormat("%B")(start) + "\u2013" + d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(end)
    : d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(start) + "\u2013" + d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(end)
}

rowReady = row => Boolean(row) && complete(row) && isPublishedNumber(row)

onlyOne = (rows, label) => {
  if (rows.length !== 1) throw new Error(label + ": expected one public row per month.")
  return rows[0]
}

formatCount = value =>
  Number.isFinite(Number(value))
    ? Math.round(Number(value)).toLocaleString("en-GB")
    : "Unavailable"

definitionCode = choice =>
  choice === "Inclusive"
    ? "upper_clear_likely_possible"
    : "primary_clear_likely"
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
eventRows = eventMetrics.filter(row =>
  row.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-001" &&
  row.period_type === "monthly" &&
  row.event_type === "all_cvd" &&
  row.sex === "all" &&
  row.age_group === "all" &&
  row.ascertainment_scope === "hospital_only" &&
  row.statistic === "monthly_count"
)

mortalityRows = mortalityMetrics.filter(row =>
  row.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
  row.period_type === "monthly" &&
  row.event_type === "all_cvd" &&
  row.sex === "all" &&
  row.age_group === "all" &&
  (row.case_definition === "primary_clear_likely" ||
   row.case_definition === "upper_clear_likely_possible") &&
  row.statistic === "monthly_count"
)

eventByMonth = d3.rollup(eventRows, rows => onlyOne(rows, "Events"), monthKey)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
selectedMortalityRows = mortalityRows.filter(row =>
  row.case_definition === definitionCode(mortalityChoice)
)

mortalityByMonth = d3.rollup(
  selectedMortalityRows,
  rows => onlyOne(rows, "Mortality"),
  monthKey
)

commonMonths = Array.from(eventByMonth.keys())
  .filter(key => mortalityByMonth.has(key))
  .sort()

eligibleMonths = commonMonths.filter(key =>
  rowReady(eventByMonth.get(key)) &&
  rowReady(mortalityByMonth.get(key))
)

latestMonth = eligibleMonths.length
  ? eligibleMonths[eligibleMonths.length - 1]
  : null

latestSummary = latestMonth
  ? {
      month: latestMonth,
      events: Number(eventByMonth.get(latestMonth).display_value),
      deaths: Number(mortalityByMonth.get(latestMonth).display_value)
    }
  : null

lastThreeMonths = latestMonth
  ? [-2, -1, 0].map(offset => shiftMonth(latestMonth, offset))
  : []

lastThreeReady =
  lastThreeMonths.length === 3 &&
  lastThreeMonths.every(key =>
    rowReady(eventByMonth.get(key)) &&
    rowReady(mortalityByMonth.get(key))
  )

lastThreeSummary = lastThreeReady
  ? {
      months: lastThreeMonths,
      events: d3.sum(lastThreeMonths, key => Number(eventByMonth.get(key).display_value)),
      deaths: d3.sum(lastThreeMonths, key => Number(mortalityByMonth.get(key).display_value))
    }
  : null
```

```{ojs}
summaryCard = ({kind, label, value, note}) => {
  const card = document.createElement("div")
  card.className = "bnr-update-summary-card bnr-update-" + kind + "-card"

  const labelNode = document.createElement("div")
  labelNode.className = "bnr-update-card-label"
  labelNode.textContent = label

  const valueNode = document.createElement("div")
  valueNode.className = "bnr-update-card-value"
  valueNode.textContent = formatCount(value)

  const noteNode = document.createElement("div")
  noteNode.className = "bnr-update-card-note"
  noteNode.textContent = note

  card.append(labelNode, valueNode, noteNode)
  return card
}

summaryGrid = cards => {
  const grid = document.createElement("div")
  grid.className = "bnr-update-card-grid"
  cards.forEach(card => grid.append(card))
  return grid
}

availabilityNotice = text => {
  const note = document.createElement("div")
  note.className = "bnr-update-unavailable"
  note.textContent = text
  return note
}
```

## Rolling 12-month trend

The current line accumulates the 12 complete months ending at the latest common
month. Background lines show the same 12-month sequence shifted back by whole
years. Only complete published 12-month blocks are included.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
rollingBlock = (byMonth, endMonth, yearsBack = 0) => {
  if (!endMonth) return null

  const shiftedEnd = shiftMonth(endMonth, -12 * yearsBack)
  const months = d3.range(-11, 1).map(offset => shiftMonth(shiftedEnd, offset))

  if (!months.every(key => rowReady(byMonth.get(key)))) return null

  const series = monthRangeLabel(months)
  let cumulative = 0

  return months.map((month, index) => {
    cumulative += Number(byMonth.get(month).display_value)
    return {
      axisMonth: monthShortLabel(month),
      cumulative,
      month,
      series,
      yearsBack,
      step: index + 1
    }
  })
}

rollingComparators = (byMonth, endMonth) => {
  if (!endMonth || !byMonth.size) return []

  const earliestSerial = d3.min(Array.from(byMonth.keys()), monthSerial)
  const maximumYearsBack = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.floor((monthSerial(endMonth) - earliestSerial) / 12)
  )

  return d3.range(1, maximumYearsBack + 1)
    .map(yearsBack => rollingBlock(byMonth, endMonth, yearsBack))
    .filter(block => block !== null)
}

eventRollingCurrent = rollingBlock(eventByMonth, latestMonth, 0)
eventRollingComparators = rollingComparators(eventByMonth, latestMonth)

mortalityRollingCurrent = rollingBlock(mortalityByMonth, latestMonth, 0)
mortalityRollingComparators = rollingComparators(mortalityByMonth, latestMonth)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cumulativeTrendPlot = (current, comparators, plotWidth) => {
  if (!current) return null

  const historical = comparators.flat()
  const marks = [Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#d8e0e4"})]

  if (historical.length) {
    marks.push(
      Plot.line(historical, {
        x: "axisMonth",
        y: "cumulative",
        z: "series",
        stroke: "#607780",
        strokeOpacity: 0.18,
        strokeWidth: 1.25
      })
    )
  }

  marks.push(
    Plot.line(current, {
      x: "axisMonth",
      y: "cumulative",
      stroke: "#045174",
      strokeWidth: 3
    })
  )

  marks.push(
    Plot.dot(current.slice(-1), {
      x: "axisMonth",
      y: "cumulative",
      fill: "#045174",
      r: 4
    })
  )

  return Plot.plot({
    width: plotWidth,
    height: 340,
    marginLeft: 62,
    marginRight: 22,
    marginBottom: 42,
    style: {
      fontFamily: "inherit",
      fontSize: "13px",
      background: "transparent"
    },
    x: {
      domain: current.map(row => row.axisMonth),
      label: null
    },
    y: {
      grid: true,
      label: "Cumulative count",
      nice: true
    },
    marks
  })
}

rollingSummaryText = (current, subject) => {
  if (!current) {
    return "A complete 12-month series is not available for " + subject + "."
  }
  const total = current[current.length - 1].cumulative
  return monthRangeLabel(current.map(row => row.month)) + ": " +
    formatCount(total) + " " + subject + "."
}
```

<div class="bnr-update-source-note">
All event counts on this page are hospital-recorded counts. Death counts use the
selected Primary or Inclusive mortality definition. Simple monthly, three-month
and cumulative 12-month totals are calculated only from published display
values that are complete and not suppressed. A required value is never inferred
when it is unavailable.
</div>

The calculations on this page read the complete release snapshots stored with
this dated report. The links above identify the corresponding published source
datasets.
